features.title: Settle the unattributed points instead of clamping one side of them
features.user_visible_behavior: A run where every cleared room was attributed reports 0 unattributed rooms, not 3.552713678800501e-15 of one.
verification_manual: Play a run in which every cleared room had somebody in it.
Open the written report in config/sighteaddons/runs/.
Verify `unattributed` reads 0.0 and carries no exponent.

evidence.result: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 10s, 7 actionable tasks: 7 executed. The four new RunReportTest cases pass: 'the split residue is not reported as a fraction of a room', 'the residue this removes is the one the point split actually produces', 'the residue drifts in both directions, which is what the clamp alone missed', 'a negative never reaches the report', plus 'a genuinely unattributed room still counts'.

BASELINE: PASSING. Regression check over the whole suite: build/test-results/test/*.xml sums to classes 11, tests 84, skipped 0, failures 0, errors 0 — up from 79, with no existing test changed or removed.

BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Deliberately not './gradlew build': build is finalizedBy copyToDist, and refreshing dist/sighteaddons-0.9.0.jar would leave the committed jar no longer the released 0.9.0 artifact. 'git status --short dist/' is empty.

features.notes: NOT a schema change and NOT paired with the receiver: `unattributed` is already in RUN_KEYS (ingest.py:138) and validated as _real(x, 0, MAX_CLEARED) (ingest.py:226), so nothing has to be deployed first and no field is added, removed or retyped. Diff done before touching RunReport.kt, as CLAUDE.md requires. Origin: POINTS_PER_ROOM is 1.0 and DungeonGrid.splitPoints divides it by tick counts, so a room shared three ways credits 0.333... three times and the sum drifts a few ULPs across a floor; roomsCleared - pointsByPlayer().values.sum() then yields a residue instead of a zero. The existing coerceAtLeast(0.0) in RunReport.build was written for exactly this and was one-sided, so +3.55e-15 went through and reached profiles/, which is append-only and can never be corrected. Fixed by ContributionTracker.settle (round to the two decimals every display path already truncates to, then clamp), applied in build() — the documented pure seam, so `write` and any caller passing `unattributed` directly are both covered. RoomHistory.printSummary computed the same expression inline behind its own `> 0.01`; both sites now call ContributionTracker.unattributed(), so the duplicated expression is gone rather than doubled. Genuinely non-zero values are untouched on purpose: a room cleared with nobody ever seen in it is a real unattributed point, and the gap to roomsCleared is the receiver's own diagnostic for a broken decoration mapping (agent/AGENT-PROMPT.md:62). mod_version stays 0.9.0, so the release gate did not fire — which also means the fix reaches players only at the next bump and release.

features.title: Anchor enterTick on a minimum stay
features.user_visible_behavior: A room a party member only passed through no longer reports that pass-through as the room's clear time.
verification_manual: Capture a debug session from a real run with a split party.
Find a room somebody passed through long before the clear.
Verify the reported clear does not start at the pass-through.

evidence.result: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 7s, 7 actionable tasks: 7 executed. ContributionTrackerTest tests=16 failures=0 errors=0 (the class did not exist before this feature); RunReportTest tests=21 failures=0 errors=0. The cases that pin the anchor: 'a walk-through does not anchor the room', 'a clear long after a walk-through reports no anchor at all', 'a member who passes through and comes back is anchored on the return', 'two walk-throughs by one member never add up to a stay', 'the anchor is the start of the qualifying stay, not the tick it qualified', 'a gap shorter than the threshold does not split a stay', 'the fallback can never manufacture a clear longer than the threshold', 'nothing anchors a room after it was cleared'.

BASELINE: PASSING. Regression check over the whole suite: build/test-results/test/*.xml sums to classes 12, tests 101, skipped 0, failures 0, errors 0 — up from 84. No existing test was removed or weakened. Two existing RunReportTest assertions were updated because this feature deliberately changes what they pin: 'run context survives' now expects v=5, and the shared room fixture earns enteredAtTick through onPresence instead of assigning it (the setter is private now), landing on the same 120 the assertions have always expected.

BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 4s. Deliberately not './gradlew build': build is finalizedBy copyToDist and copyToDist dependsOn cleanDist, so it would delete and replace dist/sighteaddons-0.9.0.jar with a jar that is no longer the released 0.9.0. 'git status --short dist/ gradle.properties' is empty — no version bump, so the release gate at the top of CLAUDE.md did not fire.

evidence.command: Dropped the 'stay.ticks < MIN_TICKS' clause from TrackedRoom.onPresence (i.e. reverted to first-sighting anchoring); ./gradlew test --tests 'sighteaddons.ContributionTrackerTest' --tests 'sighteaddons.RunReportTest' --rerun-tasks   (mutation check, reverted immediately)

Evidence that the new tests pin the behaviour rather than the shape of the implementation: a silent return to the schema-4 anchor cannot pass this suite. Source restored and re-verified in the run above.

features.notes: PAIRED with the receiver's schema-001, which was DEPLOYED FIRST and is live on master at f1085a7 — verified before this feature started, so the order CLAUDE.md fixes was respected. CORRECTION TO THIS NOTE'S EARLIER RATIONALE, checked against the receiver's source rather than trusted: this pair has no 400 in it and never did. ingest.py:214 validates `v` as _num(x, 1, 10), so v=5 was already accepted before the receiver moved, and ingest.py:159 has had `enterTick` in ROOM_OPTIONAL since schema 3. No field is added, removed or retyped here — only the meaning of an existing one changes — so nothing would have rejected this build and the 'loses every run of it' claim did not apply. The receiver corrected the mirror image of the same false rationale on its own side. WHAT THE REAL RISK IS, and it is worse than a 400 because it is silent: roomstats.py routes the clear span on the report's `v` alone (STAY_ANCHOR_SCHEMA = 5), below 5 into `clear` and at-or-above into `clearStay`, never mixing them. Shipping the stay anchor with SCHEMA left at 4 would fold every stay-anchored span back into the old sighting-anchored average — no 400, no log line, and profiles/ is append-only so the mean could never be cleaned. Hence SCHEMA 4 -> 5 in RunReport.kt as part of this feature, and a test that fails if the anchor is stay-based while v < 5. WHY IT MATTERS: the receiver's roomstats.py docstring — `clear` was an upper bound, not a duration, because enterTick was stamped the first time ANY party member was seen in the room with no minimum stay, so 145 s got reported for a 1x1. HOW IT IS ANCHORED NOW: TrackedRoom tracks a current stay per member (start, ticks, lastSeen) instead of only the run-long tick total, and enteredAtTick is the start of the first stay to reach MIN_TICKS — its own start, not the tick it qualified at, since the latter would shorten every clear in the data by a flat second. Sighting gaps of up to MIN_TICKS do not split a stay, because PartyTracker.positions deliberately reports no teammate positions at all for the 10-20 ticks around a death. A room that clears before anyone qualifies falls back to the earliest stay begun within the last MIN_TICKS: without that, the empty 1x1s that clear on entry (three in one M7, per the count in ContributionTracker.award) would carry no anchor at all and the server's mean would be built from every room EXCEPT the fastest — a bias rather than sparsity. The fallback's window is what makes it safe, since every span it can produce is under a second by construction and it can never reach back to an old walk-through. Nothing anchors after the clear, so enterTick <= clearTick holds whenever both are set, and a preCleared room now reports a null anchor for its whole life (honest: there is no clear of ours to time, and roomstats.py:102 skips preCleared rooms anyway). enteredAtTick is `private set` so the invariant has exactly one home. NOT SHIPPED: no version bump and no dist/ refresh, so this reaches no install until the next release, which is the user's decision.

features.title: ClearPoints proper — weight rooms instead of counting them
features.user_visible_behavior: A cleared puzzle or a secret-heavy room is worth more than an empty 1x1, so the score separates players the flat count cannot.
verification_manual: Verify a puzzle room and a plain 1x1 no longer carry the same points.
features.notes: README 'Not implemented yet': every room is still worth 1 point, which reproduces exactly the flat weighting this metric is meant to replace. The inputs already exist — rooms.json carries the secret and crypt counts, and DungeonSession.floorNumber is available for floor multipliers. rooms.json is Odin's database verbatim and must not be edited or regenerated to fit.

features.title: Read the events Hypixel puts in chat
features.user_visible_behavior: Secret clicks, wither doors, puzzle solvers and deaths are attributed as they happen rather than inferred.
verification_manual: Capture a debug session from a real run.
Verify a death appears at the tick chat announced it, not when the tab list caught up.
features.notes: README 'Not implemented yet'. Today a dead player is only detected via the tab list, which is late and lossy. The test class does not exist yet — creating it is part of the feature.

features.title: Records per floor, not collapsed across them
features.user_visible_behavior: A room that is genuinely harder on F7 than on F5 shows two records instead of one blended number.
verification_manual: Run /sa pbs with history from more than one floor.
Verify the same room can hold a separate record per floor.
features.notes: README 'Not implemented yet': /sa collapses floors into one record per room and kind. The data is already there — the history lines carry floor — so this is a fold and a filter, not a capture change. Watch RoomHistory.kt:59: the whole history is in memory.

features.title: Party sync instead of the decoration-order heuristic
features.user_visible_behavior: Two players standing on one decoration are told apart, and secrets are attributed per player.
verification_manual: Capture a debug session from a real run with a full party.
Verify no member is dropped and no two members map to one decoration.
features.notes: README 'Not implemented yet'. Replaces the ponytail: assumption at PartyTracker.kt:134 that decoration order matches tab order — the same heuristic Skyblocker and Odin use, and the failure the receiver's AGENT-PROMPT.md tells the analysis agent to look for. Room names no longer need it, so the remaining value is per-player attribution.

features.title: Confirm calibration, decorations, checkmarks and core hashing against real Hypixel data
features.user_visible_behavior: Room names, checkmarks and timing are known to be right in a real dungeon, not only in unit tests.
verification_manual: Play a real floor with the mod installed and telemetry on.
Open the session jsonl it wrote.
Compare named rooms, checkmark states and clear ticks against what the run actually did.
features.blocked_reason: Loom's dev client has no valid session and cannot reach Hypixel, so no command in this repository can produce the data. Unblocking needs a human to play a floor with the mod installed and hand over the debug session file. Until then this stays blocked — it is not work a session can finish.
features.notes: README 'Known limits': the build compiles and the grid, timing and tab-parsing logic are unit tested, but calibration, decoration mapping, checkmark reading and core hashing have never run against real Hypixel data. The /sa screen is one step further down — its API use is pinned by the compiler and its record fold is unit tested, but no pixel of it has ever been on screen. Note also that the room database is version-coupled: core hashes are built from Block.toString() in a fixed order, so RoomDatabase.coreAt must be re-verified whenever Hypixel changes a room or Mojang changes that representation.
